## What we use

Receiver electrical characteristics (noise figure, gain range, linearity,
filter corners, synthesiser step, phase noise, spurs, reference frequency) for
SPEC-001 and G05. Restated with page references in
`vendor/summary/analog-devices-max2851.md`. No figure, table or text is
reproduced.
